care_actions_medication_fields_check.name: care_actions_medication_fields_check
care_actions_medication_fields_check.value: "care_actions"."action_type" <> 'medication' or ("care_actions"."medication_name" is not null and "care_actions"."medication_dose" > 0 and "care_actions"."medication_dose_unit" is not null)

care_events_manual_actor_required.name: care_events_manual_actor_required
care_events_manual_actor_required.value: "care_events"."source" <> 'manual' or ("care_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "care_events"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "care_events"."client_request_id" is not null)

care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_re.name: care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_required
care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_re.value: "care_handoff_checkpoints"."source" <> 'manual' or ("care_handoff_checkpoints"."actor_user_id" is not null and "care_handoff_checkpoints"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "care_handoff_checkpoints"."client_request_id" is not null)

feeding_components_shape_check.name: feeding_components_shape_check
feeding_components_shape_check.value:
(
        ("feeding_components"."component_type" = 'direct_breastfeeding' and "feeding_components"."duration_minutes" > 0 and "feeding_components"."amount_ml" is null and "feeding_components"."liquid_type" is null and "feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" is null)
        or
        ("feeding_components"."component_type" = 'bottle' and "feeding_components"."amount_ml" > 0 and "feeding_components"."liquid_type" is not null and "feeding_components"."duration_minutes" is null and ("feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" is null or "feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" > 0))
      )
